sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: What is the energy (in $\mathrm{J\ atom^{-1}}$) required for the following process ? $\ce{Li^2+(g) -> Li^3+(g) + e-}$ (Take the ionization energy for the H atom in the ground state as $2.18\times10^{-18}\ \mathrm{J\ atom^{-1}}$)
stem.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रक्रम के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा ($\mathrm{J\ atom^{-1}}$ में) क्या है ? $\ce{Li^2+(g) -> Li^3+(g) + e-}$ (मूल अवस्था में H परमाणु की आयनन ऊर्जा $2.18\times10^{-18}\ \mathrm{J\ atom^{-1}}$ लीजिए)

feynman.en: $\ce{Li^2+}$ has one electron, so it is hydrogen-like and its ionisation energy scales as $Z^2$.
feynman.hi: $\ce{Li^2+}$ में एक इलेक्ट्रॉन है, अतः यह हाइड्रोजन-सदृश है और इसकी आयनन ऊर्जा $Z^2$ के अनुपात में है।

why.en: That is $Z^2$ times the energy with the power of ten slipped; $9 \times 2.18=19.62$.
why.hi: इसमें $Z^2$ से गुणा तो है पर दस की घात गलत है; $9 \times 2.18=19.62$।
